#mobiledev #flutter #reactnative #pushnotifications #saasinnovation  

I build apps that people actually use—no fluff, just functionality. As a mobile developer at CloudNest Technologies, I’ve spent the last two years shaping tools for SaaS teams that save time and reduce friction. My focus? Making cross-platform experiences feel native.  

Flutter has been a game-changer for us. I led the migration of our flagship app to Flutter, cutting development time by 40% while maintaining pixel-perfect UIs across iOS and Android. It’s the backbone of our team’s productivity now. React Native also plays a role—especially for legacy modules—though I’ll always push for Flutter when possible.  

Push notifications? That’s where I get creative. I’ve designed campaigns that boosted user retention by 25% by aligning timing with user behavior. It’s not just about sending alerts; it’s about creating value.  

When I’m not coding, I’m tinkering with TypeScript to make our codebase more maintainable. And yes, I’ve dabbled in Android and iOS workflows—though I’d rather focus on Flutter’s strengths. Mobile CI/CD is part of my routine, ensuring changes land smoothly without breaking anything.  

This space is always evolving, and I’m excited to keep learning as we scale. Let’s build something great.
